brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, preferably 1600x900 or larger, opaque PNG. New artwork for バスケまとめ. The fixed article compares Tokyo United and Veltex Shizuoka registered players' season-average EFF before the October 29 and 30 games. It does NOT predict participation or results. Text below is the complete allowed content; do not import scores, player names or dates from prior example artwork.

Visual style reference already inspected in conversation: B-culver-black-lime-v3.png. Match its dark charcoal #151A18, acid lime #CCF43B brush marks, warm ivory bold Japanese typography, confident hand-drawn black ink and dry-brush athletic illustration, minimal elements. No photorealism. Do not copy the example player's face or its statistics.

Draw exactly TWO REAL athletes, with identity based on the two inspected OFFICIAL portraits:
1. Jordan Faison (ジョーダン・フェイゾン), Tokyo United. Official portrait https://tubc.tokyo/team/players/detail/id=60151 ; image https://bleague.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=2026103109/files/user/roster/2725/2026-27/12648_01.jpg . Appearance: very closely shaved scalp with receding hairline, broad oval head, full neatly edged black beard below chin and along jaw, connected mustache, strong broad nose, defined brows, deep-set eyes, medium-dark skin, muscular broad shoulders. Plain muted cyan basketball jersey, NO logo, lettering or numbers.
2. Tre'Darius McCallum (トレダリアス・マカラム), Shizuoka. Official portrait https://www.bleague.jp/roster_detail/?PlayerID=51000685 ; image https://www.bleague.jp/files/user/roster/1637/2026-27/51000685_03.png . Appearance: short rounded dense black afro, fuller projecting black beard, connected mustache, broad nose, warm wide mouth, dark skin, athletic build. Plain muted orange jersey, NO logo, lettering or numbers. His left arm has understated dark tattoo shapes. Distinguish the two actual faces clearly; keep highlights and recognizable facial features, do not obscure faces into silhouettes.

Composition: left 48% for clean striking stacked Japanese type, right 52% for a dynamic imagined one-on-one basketball scene. Faison in foreground in a twisting low post/triple-threat stance holding an orange basketball securely in BOTH hands near his right hip. McCallum behind and to the right facing him in an athletic defensive stance, one hand raised and the other extended sideways with clear natural anatomy. Both faces visible in three-quarter angle. Frame around knees/thighs with all heads, visible arms, hands and the entire ball safely inside canvas. Legs can exit lower illustration region naturally, but do not overlap the bottom caption. Both same approximate body height. Space the bodies so hands and faces never merge. Two people only; no spectators, no hoop required, no extra balls. Energetic diagonal lime brush strokes behind athletes, restrained grain. This is an explicitly imagined illustration, never a claim these players actually matched up or participated.

Exact text, use clean thick Japanese gothic lettering, high contrast and no malformed glyphs. Hierarchy and location:
- small top left masthead: "バスケまとめ"
- adjacent small date: "2026.10.27"
- largest main headline left: "東京U×静岡"
- large lime line: "今季平均EFF"
- large ivory line: "登録選手を比較"
- smaller supporting line: "10/29・30の2連戦"
- clear readable qualifier below supporting text: "出場・勝敗の予測ではありません"
- bottom footer on solid dark band, fully readable with generous margins: "イラスト（AI生成）｜成績をもとにしたイメージ"

Text occupies left panel, illustration right. Around 5% safe inset. Footer approximately 3% of canvas height, visually legible. Keep typography bold and uncluttered. No player names on artwork, no score or EFF values, no performance claims, no league/team/sponsor logos, no branding on ball or clothing, no official photograph pasted anywhere. Preserve 16:9 aspect ratio.

SINGLE REVISION
Edit image 1, the finished basketball thumbnail, and return exactly one final 16:9 PNG at the same or higher resolution. Image 2 is the OFFICIAL Jordan Faison portrait, image 3 is the OFFICIAL Tre'Darius McCallum portrait, both supporting identity references only, not content to paste.

Make only this focused illustration correction while keeping ALL typography, words, numbers, the dark charcoal/lime palette, brush texture, two-player action and the text-panel layout EXACTLY intact:
Recompose the right-side illustrated athletes just enough within the canvas so the orange player's rightmost elbow and entire arm are visible, no arm or hand touches/crosses the outer edge, with about 3% horizontal margin and 3% clearance above the raised fingers. Keep bodies substantial in the same lower-right region. Keep complete ball and both faces visible. Lower thighs may naturally crop at the bottom. Do not add any new objects or people.
Refine likeness from the two official supporting portraits. Faison in cyan must retain his very closely shaved scalp, broad oval face, broad nose, connected mustache and full close beard and strong build, matching image 2. McCallum in orange should match image 3: SHORT, evenly rounded dense afro, not tall/angular hair; full rounded beard, not a pointed goatee; broad nose, and characteristic wide mouth. Preserve the alert competitive expressions and hand-drawn illustration style. No photographs pasted, no photographic rendering. Both athletes have two anatomically coherent arms and natural five-digit hands, with Faison holding the ball in both hands and McCallum defending. Simplify overlapping fingers if necessary. No logos or clothing text.

Keep these exact existing lines, spelling and punctuation:
バスケまとめ
2026.10.27
東京U×静岡
今季平均EFF
登録選手を比較
